title: データサイエンス基礎Ⅱ
subtitle: Data Science for Beginners 2
courseType:
Mathematics and Science Program
Mathematics and Science Courses
keywords: machine learning 2.cluster analysis 3.decision tree 4.neural network 5. MATLAB,MS Excel
educationalGoal: Utilization of data is indispensable for realizing the smart society Society 5.0, and it will be indispensable in the future to acquire a background in data science. In this lecture, we will discuss, 1) Cluster analysis 2) Decision tree analysis 3) (artificial) neural networks The goal is to acquire the three methods through lectures and exercises.
advice: In this class, we will learn "classification (discrimination)" and "prediction", which are important uses of data science, through lectures and exercises. First, we will understand what machine learning is, and learn the theory and usage of three typical methods: cluster analysis, decision tree analysis, and (artificial) neural network. "Cluster analysis" groups similar things together It is a method that is representative of unsupervised machine learning. ``Decision tree'' is a technique for automatically creating a tree structure for classification, and is a powerful technique for machine learning with supervised data. An “(artificial) neural network” simulates the brain nervous system. It is a powerful method of machine learning with supervised data. Each time, in addition to lectures based on classroom lectures, we will conduct exercises in which we actually move our hands and perform analysis. The mathematical explanation of the mathematical background of each method is kept to a minimum to facilitate understanding of the method. Make sure you take the time to explain. Any unclear points should be resolved during class, and time should be allocated for review.
books: Do not use textbooks. References will be given as appropriate in class.
requiredKnowledge: It is compulsory to take the preceding course, "Fundamentals of Data Science I". Furthermore, it is strongly recommended that students also take ``Statistics for Engineers'' to learn the basics of statistics. Please bring your own laptop PC because analysis tools will be used in every class.

lessons.content: Guidance: Use and significance of data science. Laws and ethics related to data science ・Machine learning ・Supervised learning ・Unsupervised learning (reinforcement learning) ・Prediction and classification ・Analysis tool setup

lessons.content: cluster analysis (1) ・Unsupervised learning ・Distance and similarity ・Hierarchical clustering (example: iris data, etc.) ・Dendrogram (tree diagram), etc. ・Practice

lessons.content: Decision tree analysis (1) ・Information gain and randomness (impurity) ・Branching (and pruning) ・CART (Example: One example is the life and death of passengers on the passenger ship Titanic. Other specific examples may be used depending on the situation.) ・Practice
